title: Fraction localization and sequential localization give the same local completeness condition
statement: Let C be a small site, R a commutative ring sheaf, U an object, f a section over U, and K an arbitrary object of D(R). The internal Hom from the sheafification of sectionwise localization R_U[1/f] to exact derived restriction of K is zero if and only if K is f-complete in the sequential-colimit and chosen-representative convention [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element]. Localization and restriction are those of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization], [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-section-localization], [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction] and [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction]. No boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The cokernel of one minus the forward shift on the coproduct of the multiplication sequence is its colimit: maps annihilating one minus shift are exactly compatible cocones. Apply the free resolution of localization to identify this cokernel with the sheafified localization. The component maps send a at stage n to a/f^n. Naturality of localization maps follows from their action on coefficients and the inverse of f.

proof.text: The factorization isomorphism for the exact slice functor and Q.objObjPreimageIso identify exact derived restriction with restriction of the chosen representative. Apply derived internal Hom to the resulting isomorphisms of source and target; isomorphic objects have the same zero condition.

lean.statement:
theorem localCompleteness_models_iff
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} (localCoefficientRings R))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((localCoefficientRings R).over U))]
    (K : ringedSiteDerived R) (U : C) (f : R.obj.obj (op U)) :
    IsZero ((derivedInternalHom (J.over U) (R.over U)).obj
      (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        (ringedSectionLocalization (R.over U) (ringedSliceSection R U f))),
        (ringedDerivedRestriction R U).obj K)) ↔
      IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U f
